new.en: Starting a new school year always feels exciting.
new.cn: 开始新学年总是让人激动。

term.en: We have many group projects this term.
term.cn: 这学期我们有很多小组项目。

classmate.en: I have made three new classmates this week.
classmate.cn: 这周我交了三个新同学。

introduce.en: Please introduce yourself to the class with a smile.
introduce.cn: 请微笑着向全班做自我介绍。

hope.en: I hope to learn a lot.
I hope my classmates and I become close friends.
hope.cn: 希望我和同学们成为亲密的朋友。

grade.en: Students in Grade 5 study many new subjects.
grade.cn: 五年级的学生要学很多新科目。

schedule.en: Our new schedule has English class every morning.
schedule.cn: 新课表每天早上都有英语课。

exciting.en: Starting Grade 5 is the most exciting moment of the year.
exciting.cn: 升入五年级是一年中最激动的时刻。
